email_body:
Hi Jay,

I came across Abandoned Echoes of Tennessee, your upcoming November 2026 photography book, which already has pre-orders open. Your work documenting forgotten buildings across the state, alongside your Route 66 Roadscapes road trip book, gives readers a real sense of travel through overlooked places. It is impressive to see a Nashville photographer build a shelf of 15 books.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Abandoned Echoes of Tennessee is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Abandoned Echoes of Tennessee best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
